title: Readings
description: Readings on the first Thursday of every month: the author, the book and a chair by the window.

sections.title: Readings
sections.lead: An author reads for half an hour, then we talk. Free, with tea; seats go to whoever comes first.

items.title: The Long Shore
items.description: The author reads the keeper’s last three letters and answers questions.

items.title: Salt and Ink
items.description: An evening of maps: the essayist brings the harbour charts behind the book.

items.title: Small Boats
items.description: An afternoon reading for children, with paper boats to fold and take home.

items.title: Do I need a ticket?
items.text: No. Readings are free; seats go to whoever comes first, and the doors open half an hour before.

items.title: Can I get my book signed?
items.text: Yes. Authors stay after the reading to sign books, bought here or brought from home.
